title: Smoky Uruguayan Skewers
description: A flavorful and spicy Uruguayan-inspired dish featuring smoky skewers of meat and vegetables, served with a sweet and tangy plum sauce.

ingredients.name: Uruguayan seasoning
ingredients.notes: Mix of paprika, garlic, and oregano

instructions: 2. Cut the baby back ribs into 1-inch cubes.
3. Thread the rib pieces, tomato, and onion onto the skewers.
4. Brush the skewers with olive oil and sprinkle with Uruguayan seasoning.
5. Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally.
6. While the skewers are cooking, heat the plum sauce in a small saucepan over medium heat.
7. Serve the skewers hot with the plum sauce spooned over the top.
